title: Email Verification, Private Notes & Fully Static Engine
changes: Email verification with OTP and reset links for accounts
Private notes excluded from GitHub and bundle — admin-only via DB
Fully static engine with zero server round-trips on navigation

title: Taskwarrior RPG Engine & Mobile Optimization
changes: Taskwarrior RPG system with level progression, class ranks, and live XP tracking
Dynamic XP rewards for task completion, published notes, writing streaks, and Night Owl focus hours
Mobile navigation support with drawer menu access, footer shortcuts, and optimized touch views for Taskwarrior & Rhythm

title: Selective Draft Publishing Protection
changes: Strict publishing pipeline: Only notes with 'draft: false' frontmatter are deployed to the live garden
Automatic draft filtering: Notes with 'draft: true' or unlisted drafts are strictly ignored during deployment
Ensures private vault notes and work-in-progress thoughts remain safe and protected

title: Voice Notes & PDF Import
changes: Send audio voice messages via Telegram to auto-generate Markdown notes
Import PDF study documents and convert them into organized notes
Added Photo OCR note converter for textbooks and handwritten notes

title: Telegram Bot Integration
changes: Remote note management via Telegram (/list, /search, /tag, /stats)
Upload .md note files directly via Telegram with automated publishing
Live step-by-step progress status notifications

title: Discussion & Comments
changes: Added Giscus discussion thread under every published note
Integrated responsive ad layout components for mobile & desktop
Enhanced search index & date formatting improvements

title: Interactive Code Runner & AI Search
changes: AI-powered natural language search assistant across all notes
Interactive code execution playground supporting Python, JS, C++, and Go

title: GitHub Open Source Launch & 2D Graph

Interactive 2D Knowledge Graph visualization for note connections
Taskwarrior task management integration synced with local setup
